capabilities: Send notes or selections to an agent
Import and catch up on saved responses
Manage a note inbox in the file explorer
Set up MCP so agents can edit notes
extras: Free and MIT-licensed, but T3 Code and model-provider accounts or usage charges are separate. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Update checks use a public relay that can see the connecting IP address and time. Voice input works only on devices with browser speech recognition; T3's remote transcription service is not yet connected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to an external AI coding agent and stream its replies back into the editor.

relations.evidence: The t3-obsidian plugin brings T3 Code into your Obsidian notes.
It sets up enabled, installed Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode agents
